headlines.text: Flash back to 2023, when Orange Cassidy vs. Angelico clashed for the AEW International Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.09. It was the first title opportunity of Angelico's career. It marked Orange Cassidy's 20th match with the title on the line. Cassidy retained the AEW International Title against Angelico, whose knee-targeting offense from a recent ROH incident set up the whole match, finishing with the Orange Punch.
Rewind to 2021, when Jeff Parker made their return to AEW television after just under 3 months away, appearing on Dynamite.

Rewind to 2023, when Bryan Danielson vs. Daniel Garcia met in a Continental Classic League Match, closing out the card as the main event on Rampage, rated 8.21 ? a fantastic contest. Danielson survived Garcia's hometown crowd and a flurry of chops to lock in the LeBell Lock, extending his unbeaten run through the Continental Classic's Blue League.
